overview: AI 交叉研究从具体学科的问题出发：分子的性质是什么，原子会怎样运动，蛋白质可能折成什么结构。模型可以替代部分昂贵计算、从数据里预测难以直接测量的量，或者帮助筛选值得进一步实验的候选。问题定义与验证方式仍然来自具体学科。
本页通过分子与蛋白质研究中的三个例子，介绍不同的应用方式：图网络学习结构与性质的关系，神经网络势能模型加速模拟，AlphaFold 预测三维结构。它们涉及不同数据与知识约束。入门时先弄懂目标量、标签来源和测试条件，再决定需要什么模型。
solves: 根据分子或材料的结构预测性质，为候选筛选提供线索。
近似昂贵的能量与力计算，让分子动力学模拟覆盖更多时间或更大系统。
根据序列等信息预测蛋白质结构，为后续分析与实验提供结构假设。
zh.stance: 模型分数回答的是一个定义好的预测问题；要把它变成学科结论，还要检查数据来源、适用条件和独立验证。

roadmap.title: 把学科结构放进表示
roadmap.text: MPNN 用消息传递统一分子图上的学习方法，让原子与关系参与性质预测。

roadmap.title: 用模型加速计算过程
roadmap.text: Deep Potential 从第一性原理数据学习能量与力，将学习得到的模型用于分子动力学计算。

roadmap.title: 围绕具体难题设计系统
roadmap.text: AlphaFold2 将序列、进化信息与几何结构结合来预测蛋白质三维结构。

terms.text: 模型设计里预先放入的假设，例如分子旋转后某些预测性质应保持不变。
图里的节点从相邻节点和边接收信息，再更新自己的表示，逐层整合局部结构。
用计算成本较低的模型近似昂贵的计算过程。需要比较误差是否会影响后续模拟或决策。
测试与训练不同的条件，例如新分子骨架或新温度范围，以检查模型在目标用途下是否可靠。

checklist: 选一个数据集，写清一个样本代表什么、标签怎样得到、量的单位是什么。
做一个简单预测参照，并检查训练与测试是否共享过于相似的样本或同一来源的重复记录。
为一个模型结果写出下一步验证：换哪些条件测试，或用什么计算、实验支持它。

figure.title: 从学科问题到可以检验的结果

zh.paperIntro: 先选最接近自己学科的一篇，沿输入、目标量、数据来源、验证方式读；另外两篇用来对照模型在研究中承担的不同角色。

overview: Interdisciplinary AI starts with a question from another field: a molecule's properties, atomic motion, or a protein's structure. Models can approximate expensive calculations, predict quantities that are difficult to measure, and shortlist candidates for experiments. That field still determines the question and the standards for validating an answer.

Three molecular examples illustrate different roles: graph networks relate structure to properties, learned potentials accelerate simulation, and AlphaFold predicts three-dimensional structures. They require different data and constraints. Understand the target quantity, label source, and test conditions before choosing a model.
solves: Predict properties from molecular or material structure to help shortlist candidates.
Approximate expensive energy and force calculations for molecular dynamics.
Predict protein structures from sequences and related information, providing hypotheses for further analysis and experiments.
en.stance: A model score answers a defined prediction question. A conclusion about the underlying science also requires scrutiny of data sources, operating conditions, and independent validation.

roadmap.title: Build domain structure into representations
roadmap.text: MPNN unifies message-passing approaches to molecular property prediction, representing atoms and their relationships.

roadmap.title: Accelerate a computational process
roadmap.text: Deep Potential learns energies and forces from first-principles data and uses them in molecular dynamics simulations.

roadmap.title: Build a system around a specific hard problem
roadmap.text: AlphaFold2 combines sequences, evolutionary information, and geometry for structure prediction.

terms.text: An assumption built into model design, such as a predicted molecular property remaining unchanged after rotation.
Graph nodes receive information from neighboring nodes and edges, then update their representations.
A cheaper approximation to an expensive computation. Its errors must be checked in the subsequent simulation or decision.
Testing conditions unlike training, such as new molecular scaffolds or temperature ranges, to assess the intended use.

checklist: Choose a dataset and explain what one sample represents, how its label was obtained, and the units of the target.
Build a simple predictive baseline and check for overly similar samples or duplicated source records across the train/test split.
For one model result, specify the next validation: changed test conditions, an independent calculation, or an experiment.

figure.title: From a domain question to a testable result

en.paperIntro: Start with the paper closest to your discipline. Trace inputs, targets, data sources, and validation; use the other two to compare the roles models can play.

papers.title: Neural Message Passing for Quantum Chemistry

zh.question: 怎样从原子与它们的关系预测分子性质？
zh.idea: 节点通过消息传递更新表示，再把节点信息汇总为整个分子的预测。
zh.why: 它通过具体的量子化学预测任务，展示图网络中的抽象操作。
zh.read: 先看 message passing 与 readout，再看目标性质和数据设置。
zh.limit: 原文主要评估小分子的量子化学性质；不能据此推断对更大分子、不同化学空间或真实药物效果同样有效。

en.question: How can atoms and their relationships predict molecular properties?
en.idea: Update node representations through messages, then aggregate them for a molecular prediction.
en.why: It grounds graph learning in a concrete chemistry task.
en.read: Start with message passing, readout, targets, and data.
en.limit: The benchmark concerns quantum-chemical properties of small molecules; it does not establish transfer to larger molecules, different chemical spaces, or drug efficacy.

papers.title: Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics: A Scalable Model with the Accuracy of Quantum Mechanics

zh.question: 怎样降低分子动力学中精确计算能量与力的成本？
zh.idea: 从第一性原理数据学习原子局部环境与能量的关系，同时把问题的对称性纳入模型。
zh.why: 它展示 AI 怎样替代计算链中的一个昂贵环节。
zh.read: 先看能量与力怎样进入模拟，再看训练数据与物理量对照。
zh.limit: 模型准确性依赖训练覆盖的构型与参考计算，外推到新条件需要检验。

en.question: How can accurate energy and force calculations become cheaper?
en.idea: Learn local atomic contributions from first-principles data while preserving problem symmetries.
en.why: An example of replacing an expensive step in a scientific computation.
en.read: Trace energies and forces into simulation, then inspect physical comparisons.
en.limit: Accuracy depends on the configurations covered by the data and reference calculations; new conditions need testing.

papers.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold

zh.question: 怎样从氨基酸序列等信息预测蛋白质的三维结构？
zh.idea: 整合进化相关序列与残基间关系，反复更新表示并生成三维结构。
zh.why: 它展示数据、几何与系统设计围绕一个学科难题怎样配合。
zh.read: 先看整体结构与 CASP14 评价，再看置信度的含义。
zh.limit: 结构预测与置信度估计不等于直接测量蛋白质功能、动态变化或结合能力；具体生物学结论仍需相应证据。

en.question: How can sequence information support three-dimensional structure prediction?
en.idea: Combine evolutionary sequence information and residue relationships, iteratively refining representations and structure.
en.why: It connects data, geometry, and system design around a scientific problem.
en.read: Start with the architecture, CASP14 evaluation, and confidence estimates.
en.limit: Predicted structures and confidence estimates do not directly measure function, dynamics, or binding. Biological conclusions require evidence appropriate to those questions.

papers.title: Solving olympiad geometry without human demonstrations

zh.question: 怎样把辅助构造与符号推理连接成证明过程？
zh.idea: 符号引擎先推导已有条件，语言模型在需要时提出辅助构造，再继续搜索证明。
zh.read: 沿一个简单几何题追踪新增构造及其带来的推导，再看训练数据如何合成。
zh.limit: 系统依赖指定的几何表示、规则与辅助构造空间；奥数几何成绩不代表能够证明任意数学命题。
zh.why: 它展示模型提出的候选方案如何与可检查的符号推导配合。

en.question: How can auxiliary constructions and symbolic reasoning work together to find a proof?
en.idea: A symbolic engine first derives consequences from the given conditions. When needed, a language model proposes auxiliary constructions, and proof search continues.
en.read: Trace the added constructions and the deductions they enable in a simple geometry problem, then examine how the training data are synthesized.
en.limit: The system uses a specified geometry representation, rule set, and construction space. Results on olympiad geometry do not establish general mathematical theorem proving.
en.why: It shows how learned proposals can work with inspectable symbolic deductions.

papers.title: Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations

zh.question: 怎样学习从初始条件、系数等输入函数，到方程解的映射？
zh.idea: 在频域中参数化积分核，学习函数到函数的映射，用于一类偏微分方程问题。
zh.read: 先看算子层与输入输出，再对照不同分辨率和方程设置下的误差。
zh.limit: 学习的是训练数据覆盖的一族方程与条件；分辨率迁移不等于自动满足边界条件、守恒律或适用于任意新方程。
zh.why: 它把求解单个方程实例，与学习一族输入到解的映射区分开。

en.question: How can a model learn the map from input functions, such as initial conditions or coefficients, to equation solutions?
en.idea: Parameterize integral kernels in the frequency domain to learn mappings from functions to functions for a family of partial differential equation problems.
en.read: Start with the operator layer and the inputs and outputs, then compare errors across resolutions and equation settings.
en.limit: It learns a family of equations and conditions represented in the data. Resolution transfer does not guarantee boundary conditions, conservation laws, or accuracy on arbitrary new equations.
en.why: It distinguishes solving one equation instance from learning an input-to-solution map across a family.

papers.title: Qlib: An AI-oriented Quantitative Investment Platform

zh.question: 数据、模型、组合与回测怎样组成一个研究流程？
zh.idea: 把金融数据处理和机器学习流程连接到策略评价，使不同模型可以在统一流程中比较。
zh.read: 沿框架图追踪数据流，再找一个例子的时间划分、标签和回测配置。
zh.limit: 回测结果依赖时间划分、可用信息、交易成本与策略选择；历史回测表现不保证未来收益。
zh.why: 它提醒读者，模型只是数据到策略评价的一环。

en.question: How do data, models, portfolios, and backtesting form a research workflow?
en.idea: Connect financial data processing and machine learning pipelines to strategy evaluation so that different models can be compared within a common workflow.
en.read: Trace the data flow through the framework diagram, then identify the time split, labels, and backtesting configuration in an example.
en.limit: Backtests depend on time splits, information availability, trading costs, and strategy selection. Historical backtest performance does not guarantee future returns.
en.why: It places the model within a workflow from data preparation to strategy evaluation.

papers.title: Optuna: A Next-generation Hyperparameter Optimization Framework

zh.question: 怎样用有限的训练预算找到好的配置？
zh.idea: 以程序定义搜索空间，结合采样和剪枝，在多次试验之间分配预算。
zh.read: 先看搜索空间和试验循环，再看提前停止怎样节省计算。
zh.limit: 搜索质量取决于预算、搜索空间与验证信号；反复选择最优验证结果仍会过拟合验证集，独立测试集应保留到最后。
zh.why: 它把调参看作有预算的试验选择，而不是无记录地反复尝试。

en.question: How can a search find a good training configuration within a limited budget?
en.idea: Define the search space in code, then combine sampling and pruning to allocate the budget across trials.
en.read: Start with the search space and trial loop, then examine how early stopping saves computation.
en.limit: Search depends on the budget, search space, and validation signal. Repeated selection can overfit validation data; keep an independent test set for final evaluation.
en.why: It treats tuning as selecting trials within a budget and recording their results.

papers.title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents

zh.question: 编程 Agent 能否通过修改自身代码改善能力？
zh.idea: 维护多个 Agent 版本，生成自我修改，再用编程任务筛选，形成持续扩展的版本树。
zh.read: 从一处具体代码改动读起，再看版本选择、评价任务和计算预算。
zh.limit: 改进通过特定编程基准筛选，修改的是智能体代码而非基础模型权重；这不是对任意自我修改都有效的证明。
zh.why: 它提供了一个具体例子，用于区分智能体代码改进、参数训练与评价筛选的作用。

en.question: Can a coding agent improve its abilities by modifying its own code?
en.idea: Maintain multiple agent versions, generate self-modifications, and select candidates using coding tasks, creating an expanding version tree.
en.read: Start with one specific code change, then examine version selection, evaluation tasks, and the computation budget.
en.limit: Changes are selected on specific coding benchmarks and modify agent code, not the foundation model weights. This does not prove that arbitrary self-modification is beneficial.
en.why: It separates improvements to agent code from parameter training and evaluation-based selection.

papers.title: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search

zh.question: 怎样用实验结果引导下一轮研究？
zh.idea: 用 Agent 驱动的树搜索组织实验，连接方案、执行、分析与论文撰写。
zh.read: 先看一次完整实验分支，检查最终论述能否对应到实际结果。
zh.limit: 原文在有限机器学习任务中评估，并报告三篇自主生成的 workshop 投稿中一篇达到接收标准；这不代表已验证跨学科自主科研的可靠性。
zh.why: 它让自动化科研的每个环节都成为可以单独检查的对象。

en.question: How can experimental results guide the next round of research?
en.idea: Use agentic tree search to organize experiments, connecting plans, execution, analysis, and paper writing.
en.read: Start with one complete experimental branch and check whether the final claims correspond to actual results.
en.limit: The study covers limited ML settings and reports that one of three autonomous workshop submissions met acceptance standards. This does not establish reliable autonomous discovery across disciplines.
en.why: It makes each stage of an automated research process available for separate inspection.

papers.title: AMix-1: A Pathway to Test-Time Scalable Protein Foundation Model

zh.question: 怎样把家族信息与验证反馈用于蛋白质设计？
zh.idea: 以贝叶斯流网络建模蛋白质，利用 MSA 上下文，并探索增加推理时搜索预算的设计流程。
zh.read: 分别追踪生成条件、验证器与实验测量；比较它们在迭代中的作用。
zh.limit: 计算验证器分数与真实实验活性是不同证据；个别蛋白质家族的改进不能直接推广到所有蛋白质、功能或应用条件。
zh.why: 它连接蛋白质表示、生成、计算筛选与实验验证。

en.question: How can family information and verification feedback support protein design?
en.idea: Model proteins with Bayesian flow networks, use MSA context, and explore design workflows with larger inference-time search budgets.
en.read: Trace conditioning inputs, verifiers, and experimental measurements separately, comparing their roles in the iterative process.
en.limit: Computational verifier scores and measured activity provide different evidence. Improvements in selected protein families do not establish transfer to all proteins, functions, or conditions of use.
en.why: It connects protein representations, generation, computational screening, and experimental validation.

papers.title: FLAG: Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph for spatial gene expression prediction

zh.question: 怎样从组织图像预测空间基因表达并保留结构关系？
zh.idea: 结合空间图编码与基因基础模型表征，用扩散过程建模表达分布。
zh.read: 先看输入图像、空间邻接和表达输出，再比较逐点误差与结构评价。
zh.limit: 输出是由组织图像推断的表达分布，并非直接测得的基因表达；迁移到新患者、组织或平台时，需要独立数据检验。
zh.why: 它说明平均预测误差之外，生物结构关系也可能是评价目标。

en.question: How can tissue images predict spatial gene expression while preserving structural relationships?
en.idea: Combine spatial graph encoding with gene foundation model representations, and use a diffusion process to model expression distributions.
en.read: Start with input images, spatial adjacency, and expression outputs, then compare errors at individual locations with structural evaluations.
en.limit: The outputs are expression distributions inferred from tissue images, not direct gene-expression measurements. Transfer to new patients, tissues, or platforms needs independent evaluation.
en.why: It shows why biological structure can matter alongside average prediction error.

papers.title: DreamDiffusion: Generating High-Quality Images from Brain EEG Signals

zh.question: 脑电表征怎样连接到图像生成模型？
zh.idea: 通过时间掩码信号建模学习 EEG 表征，结合 CLIP 视觉监督，将信号用于条件生成。
zh.read: 沿训练阶段找每种数据与监督的作用，再看被试划分和对照。
zh.limit: 原文利用受控条件下的 EEG—图像配对数据；生成看似合理的图像不等于准确读取任意想法或梦境。
zh.why: 它帮助区分信号提供的信息，与预训练生成器补入的图像先验。

en.question: How can EEG representations connect to an image generation model?
en.idea: Learn EEG representations through temporally masked signal modeling, combine them with CLIP visual supervision, and use the signals for conditional generation.
en.read: Trace the role of each data source and supervision signal through the training stages, then examine participant splits and controls.
en.limit: The study uses paired EEG and images under controlled conditions. A plausible generated image does not establish accurate decoding of arbitrary thoughts or dreams.
en.why: It helps distinguish information supplied by the signal from image priors supplied by the pretrained generator.

papers.title: CMRINet: Joint Groupwise Registration and Segmentation for Cardiac Function Quantification from Cine-MRI

zh.question: 怎样从动态心脏 MRI 同时获得结构和运动信息？
zh.idea: 联合处理组间配准与分割，把时序图像分析连接到心脏功能量化。
zh.read: 先看电影 MRI 的时间维度，再看两项任务怎样配合，以及功能指标怎样计算。
zh.limit: 原文评估特定四腔心电影 MRI 数据；配准或分割指标的改善，不等于已证明跨扫描协议、跨人群的临床效果。
zh.why: 它将图像分割、运动估计与下游功能指标联系起来，同时分别评价这些结果。

en.question: How can dynamic cardiac MRI provide both structure and motion information?
en.idea: Jointly handle groupwise registration and segmentation, connecting temporal image analysis to the measurement of cardiac function.
en.read: Start with the temporal dimension of cine MRI, then examine how the two tasks work together and how functional measures are calculated.
en.limit: The evaluation uses a particular four-chamber cine-MRI dataset. Better registration or segmentation metrics do not establish clinical effectiveness across scanning protocols or populations.
en.why: It connects segmentation, motion estimation, and downstream functional measures without treating them as one score.
